title: Aries: what to know
description: The essentials of Aries in a few screens: strengths, challenges, love and work.

pages.title: Aries: the basics
pages.text: Approximate dates: Mar 21 - Apr 19. Fire element, cardinal quality, ruled by Mars.

pages.title: Courage
pages.text: Aries does not wait for the perfect moment. They take the initiative, face the challenge head on and pull the group along.

pages.title: Impatience
pages.text: Rushing can run over other people. Taking a breath before answering helps avoid regrets.

pages.title: Intense and direct
pages.text: Likes the chase and clear signals. Plays open and expects honesty back.

pages.title: The one who starts
pages.text: Great at kicking off projects, leading and fixing what is stuck.
